heading: Evaluate ideas with PM and EM regarding of the visibility and feasibility for the chat interactions.

blocks.html: I initiated a team-wide discussion on the emotional expression methods of AI characters during voice and text chats. Considering the technical constraints, time, and budget limitations, we evaluated the feasibility of various solutions. In collaboration with the development team, we arrived at a practical implementation plan.
⚙️ Technical: During the call interactions, it is technically challenging for AI characters to determine if the user has finished talking. There are technical response delays.
⏰ Time: The project development timeline is tight, and the product needs to be launched quickly in the short term.
👤 System: Our app is not one-figure based, this should affect the design in a way.
